results.criterion: From the V4 launcher, open API Request Audit and verify that the module view loads without an application error.
steps_taken: Started at the V4 launcher with the authenticated session visible.
Opened API Request Audit using its launcher card.
Verified the API Request Audit heading, filters, request metrics, charts, and request table rendered without an application error.

results.criterion: From the first API Request Audit view, use the browser Back control and verify that the V4 launcher is visible.
steps_taken: Navigated to the required launcher route to prepare this criterion.
The browser redirected to the SmartTools Authenticate sign-in page before the launcher was available.
Stopped without interacting with the sign-in form.
results.reason: Authentication preflight failed during navigation to the launcher: the visible page was “Sign in - SmartTools Authenticate” with “Sign in securely to access the platform.” The browser Back action could not be tested.

results.criterion: From the launcher reached by the browser Back control, open API Request Audit again in the same browser session and verify that the module view loads without an application error.
steps_taken: No criterion interaction was possible after the authentication preflight failure on the preceding criterion.
Captured the still-visible authentication page and stopped without interacting with the sign-in form.
results.reason: The required authenticated launcher could not be reached because the browser remained on the SmartTools Authenticate sign-in page. The second module visit was not attempted.

conciseReport: **TEST2-39 — Blocked.** The first API Request Audit view loaded without an application error. Subsequent launcher navigation redirected to the SmartTools Authenticate sign-in page, blocking the browser Back and second-visit checks. No sign-in interaction was attempted.
reason: Authentication preflight failed after the first criterion: navigating to the launcher redirected to the SmartTools Authenticate sign-in page. Criteria 2 and 3 are Blocked; no authentication form was used.
